charge_description: not maintaining her three bastard children, namely Dorothy aged 10 years, William aged 7 years, and Jane aged 5 years, whereby they became chargeable to the township of Whitby
raw_record: Summary conviction of Jane Harrison of the township of Whitby singlewoman for not maintaining her three bastard children, namely Dorothy aged 10 years, William aged 7 years, and Jane aged 5 years, whereby they became chargeable to the township of Whitby. Offence committed at the township of Whitby on 6 April 1844. Case heard at Whitby.
